purpose: Select bounded morphology candidates, construct deterministic dependency and phrase graphs, validate QAC-aligned contracts, and expose explicit Valid, Unverified, or Invalid evidence states.
prerequisites: Pinned QAC morphology and syntax inputs for corpus evaluations
inputs: Optional QAC syntax or UD evaluation corpus
invariants: Dependency direction is dependent to head.
A dependent has at most one head.
Self edges, missing nodes, duplicate nodes, cycles, and invalid phrase intervals are rejected.
Heuristic morphology never becomes corpus-backed evidence.
Unsupported syntax remains Unverified or Invalid instead of being promoted to Valid.

determinism.replayContract: Identical text, corpora, and source snapshot produce identical ordered graphs, diagnostics, metrics, and Merkle roots.

errorModel.policy: fail-closed at graph and evidence boundaries

performanceContract.verifiedScale: 6,236 Quranic verses and 680 PADT development sentences
performanceContract.guarantee: Corpus-scale completion is evidenced; no production latency or memory guarantee is claimed.

securityAndPrivacy: External licensed corpora remain outside the release package
limitations: Conditional phrase generation is dependency-driven and high precision but remains low recall at F1 0.373333333.
Broader sentence, clause, nominal, and verbal spans remain incomplete.
PADT is development data and the natural-Arabic readiness gate fails.
The parser must not be bound to a Genius or CGN transition at this quality level.
verification: Conditional phrase precision 1.0 across 14 generated comparable spans
